text:

STI-054GP-BT
s.sagatelecom@gmail.com
Saga Telecom
www.sagatelecom.com.cn
Model
STI-054GP-BT
Product mame
5 port 10/100/1000Mbps Industrial PoE Switch
4*10/100/1000M RJ45 port
Fixed Port 1*10/100/1000M Uplink RJ45 port
PoE Ports 1 port supports TEEE802.3af/ ‘at/poe + +/bt, with a maximum power of 90W per port
2-4 ports support IEEE802.3af/at, with a maximum single port power of 30W
PoE Dog Support
. af/at: 12+ 36-
PoE: Pin aflat/poet+t/bt: 12+ 45+ 36- 78-
Bandwidth 10Gbps
Packet Forwarding 7.44Mpps
MAC 2K
Buffer 2.5M
LED Indicator
PW: power indicator (green)
Uplink port: green 100M + orange 1000M
PoE port: orange PoE indicator, green grid connection indicator
V1: Main power indicator (green)
‘V2: Slave power indicator (green)
Three groups of independent power input
Power PoE: DC37-57V
Operating Temperature -40°C~+75°C
Humidity 10%~90% RH No condensation
Storage Temperature -40°C~+85°C
Humidity 95% RH No condensation
Dimension 105*90*36mm
L*W*H Packing Box: 200*130*40mm
N.W/G.W(Kg) 0.5Kg/0.6Kg
Lightning 6KV 8/20us, 8KV ESD electrostatic protection
Protection level IP40
Installation Desktop, Wall, Rack mountable(with mounting hangers)
Certificate
CE-EMC EN55032; CE-LVD EN62368
FCC Part 15Class B; RoHS
Warranty
3 Years
